name: Build Android APK

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'index.html'
      - 'template.html'
      - 'android-app/**'
      - '.github/workflows/apk.yml'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check files exist
        run: |
          missing=0
          for f in index.html template.html \
            manifest.json icons/icon-192.png \
            icons/icon-512.png \
            android-app/package.json \
            android-app/capacitor.config.json
          do
            if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then
              echo "::error::Missing: $f"
              missing=1
            fi
          done
          if [ "$missing" = "1" ]; then exit 1; fi

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17

      - name: Copy web app in
        working-directory: android-app
        run: |
          rm -rf www
          mkdir -p www
          cp ../index.html www/
          cp ../template.html www/
          cp ../manifest.json www/
          cp -r ../icons www/icons

      - name: Install
        working-directory: android-app
        run: npm install --legacy-peer-deps

      - name: Create Android project
        working-directory: android-app
        run: |
          npx cap add android
          npx cap sync android

      - name: Notification permission
        working-directory: android-app
        run: |
          M=android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml
          N=android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
          P="<uses-permission android:name=\"$N\"/>"
          if ! grep -q "$N" $M; then
            sed -i "s|<application|$P<application|" $M
          fi

      - name: Icon and splash (optional)
        working-directory: android-app
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          test -f assets/logo.png
          npx @capacitor/assets generate \
            --android \
            --iconBackgroundColor "#000000" \
            --splashBackgroundColor "#000000"

      - name: Keep signing key
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.android/debug.keystore
          key: notes-debug-keystore-v1

      - name: Build APK
        working-directory: android-app/android
        run: |
          chmod +x gradlew
          ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon

      - name: Collect APK
        run: |
          D=android-app/android/app
          D=$D/build/outputs/apk/debug
          cp $D/app-debug.apk notes.apk

      - name: Upload APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Notes-APK
          path: notes.apk
